slug: 2026-03-31 Africa we have a data problem

facts.fact: The essay's country table (Data Landscapers, an AI-assisted compilation by its own header) states that rural police stations in Comoros record case files, complaints and incident reports entirely on paper, as handwritten procès-verbaux whose originals are physically sent to prosecutors under the 2014 Criminal Procedure Code; it gives no date, so the published date is used.

The essay's country table (Data Landscapers, an AI-assisted compilation by its own header) states that it found no digital case management system, pilot or digitisation at station level in Comoros, and scores police 1 as paper-mandated; it gives no date, so the published date is used.

The essay's country table (Data Landscapers, an AI-assisted compilation by its own header) states that no station-level digital recording was found in Comoros and that justice reforms' IT equipment goes to courts, not police; it gives no count of stations and no date, so the published date is used.

note: The document is the one study.json lists under exclude_sources; its statements are recorded as it makes them and it names no police information system.
